bug_info.bug_desc: In the pre-merge kmac.sv, both `alert_test` and `alerts` concatenations placed the recoverable-operation alert at bit [1] and the fatal-fault alert at bit [0]. The alert sender generate loop instantiates `prim_alert_sender` with `IsFatal(i)`, so index 1 is the fatal sender and index 0 is the recoverable sender. As a result, fatal alert requests/tests were routed to the recoverable alert sender and recoverable alert requests/tests were routed to the fatal alert sender, causing the wrong alert channel to be exercised and the fatal/recoverable alert outputs to be swapped.
bug_info.fix_hint: Align the alert vector bit ordering with the `IsFatal(i)` parameter used in the `gen_alert_tx` loop. Place `alert_fatal` and the `fatal_fault_err` alert-test bit at index [1], and place `alert_recov_operation` and the `recov_operation_err` alert-test bit at index [0], so the fatal sender receives fatal requests/tests and the recoverable sender receives recoverable requests/tests.
